assessment_basis: Closed cited SUPPORT/CONTEXT bundle and ordinary linguistic interpretation; not a fresh provider observation. Full mapping inspected only to diagnose what is uncited, never to fill a support gap.

components.rationale: The SUPPORT states live alternatives or explicitly says the current evidence does not distinguish them. Resolving the named alternatives at the stated evidence scope preserves the contrast without inventing an outcome. A coarse span contains additional propositions; each claimed component is still explicit and can share that span with another component. Reviewed closed bundle: P002 SUPPORT.
